title: add-prompt-benchmark-ui-and-notebook
author: Avery Chen
description: Motivation: quick internal hackathon prototype to explore interactive prompt benchmarking and simple visualizations for demos. Includes a small React-based UI under /hackathons/ui and an example notebook under /examples/prompt_bench.ipynb (notebook content converted to plain JSON/text for repo). Checklist: - [x] UI skeleton and routes - [x] backend stub and mock runner - [x] sample datasets and fixtures - [x] demo script and README. Commits summary: Init UI and notebook; Add backend stub for bench runner; Wire up sample datasets and demo script; Fix lint and CI config. Changed areas: hackathons/ui/*, examples/prompt_bench.ipynb, package.json, ci/workflows/hackathon-demo.yml, README-hackathon.md. Testing notes: manual verification of UI flows, notebook runs locally against mock runner; added a small smoke test for the backend endpoint. CI: initial run failed linting, author fixed lint rules and CI, subsequent run passed. Review conversation: Lina Gomez left UX feedback about table sorting and color palette, Marco Patel requested a stubbed metrics endpoint for quick perf traces; author (Avery) responded and pushed follow-ups addressing both comments. Merge decision: approved after light cleanup; merged via squash. Notes: this is a demo/hackathon asset and not intended for production use. Follow-ups: consider extracting benchmark runner into a shared experiment package if useful.
commits: Add backend stub for bench runner
Wire up sample datasets and demo script
release_notes: Demo-only feature: interactive prompt benchmark UI and experimental notebook for hackathon. Not intended for production.
